nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and used in the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set to 'Blondi' in the BlondiDoge constructor.
Public token name string, set to 'BlondiDoge' in the BlondiDoge constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 18 in the BlondiDoge constructor.
Total token supply state variable, initialized in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): computes c = a + b and requires c >= a to guard against overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): requires b <= a and returns c = a - b, guarding underflow.
Owned() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owner-only function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Completes ownership handover; requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits event and resets newOwner.
Token constructor that sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-assigns the whole supply.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner.
ERC20 transfer: subtracts from msg.sender balance via safeSub and adds to 'to' via safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Debits 'from' balance and allowance of msg.sender and credits 'to'; no explicit allowance/balance require because SafeMath reverts.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an external callback to spender.receiveApproval before returning.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH.
Owner-only function that performs an external token.transfer(owner, tokens) call on an arbitrary address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance bookkeeping.
Balance arithmetic in transfer: balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(...) and balances[to] = safeAdd(...).
Balance/allowance arithmetic in transferFrom: safeSub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], safeAdd on balances[to].
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed with arbitrary spender data before function return.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary, caller-owner-chosen contract.
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Source address parameter of transferFrom().
Destination address parameter of transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transferFrom().
Spender contract address parameter of approveAndCall(); target of the external callback.
Allowance amount parameter of approveAndCall().
Arbitrary calldata bytes forwarded to receiveApproval().
Arbitrary token contract address parameter of transferAnyERC20Token().
Amount parameter of transferAnyERC20Token().
Named return variable c holding the result of the checked addition in safeAdd().

edges.reason: msg.sender in the Owned constructor is written directly into the owner state variable, making ownership caller-determined.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before completing the ownership transfer.
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller address feeds the balance update.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], so the caller address indexes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], so the caller address is part of the allowance key.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier evaluated on msg.sender.
Parameter 'to' of transfer is credited via safeAdd(balances[to], tokens).
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer determines the debited and credited amounts.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom selects the account whose balance and allowance are debited.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom receives the credited balance.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom is the amount subtracted and added.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall becomes the allowance key and the external callback target.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall is stored as the allowance and forwarded in the callback.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token is the arbitrary external contract called.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token is the amount passed to the external call.
transfer delegates its credit arithmetic to safeAdd.
transfer delegates its debit arithmetic to safeSub.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the destination balance.
transferFrom uses safeSub on both balances[from] and the caller allowance.
transfer's balance updates are the arithmetic risk site relying on safeSub/safeAdd require checks.
transferFrom's balance and allowance updates are the arithmetic risk site relying on safeSub/safeAdd.
approveAndCall invokes the unchecked external receiveApproval callback before the function completes.
The external receiveApproval call lets an attacker-controlled spender contract re-enter approveAndCall/transferFrom before state settles.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to a caller-selected token address.
The arbitrary external token contract can re-enter the token contract during transferAnyERC20Token.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
The constructor assigns the entire supply to balances[0xB475...e8c].
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for the caller.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external callback.
The constructor sets _totalSupply to 1e30.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus the zero-address balance.
The constructor sets symbol = 'Blondi'.
The constructor sets name = 'BlondiDoge'.
The constructor sets decimals = 18.
transferOwnership writes the _newOwner argument into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership emits OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner) and overwrites owner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the require check and then resets it to address(0).
The local return variable c in safeAdd holds the result of the checked addition.
The transfer arithmetic site depends on safeAdd's require(c >= a) to prevent overflow.
The transferFrom arithmetic site depends on safeSub's require(b <= a) to prevent underflow.
The fallback function reverts unconditionally regardless of caller, so it never processes value transfers.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter is only meaningful as the credited account inside transfer(); fold it into the transfer function node.
The 'tokens' parameter is exclusively consumed by transfer()'s balance arithmetic; fold it into transfer.
The 'from' parameter is only used to index balances and allowed within transferFrom(); fold it into transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter receives the credit inside transferFrom(); fold it into transferFrom.
The 'tokens' parameter is only used by transferFrom's debit/credit arithmetic; fold it into transferFrom.
The 'spender' parameter is both the allowance key and the target of the external receiveApproval call, so it merges into the external-call unsafe operation.
The 'tokens' parameter drives the allowance write and callback payload; fold it into approveAndCall.
The 'data' parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external callback, so it merges into the external-call unsafe operation.
'tokenAddress' is the arbitrary contract called by transferAnyERC20Token; merge it into the external-call unsafe operation.
'tokens' is only used as the amount argument of the owner-only transferAnyERC20Token call; fold it into that function.
The local return variable c exists solely inside safeAdd's checked addition; fold it into the safeAdd function node.
